Pages hold block markup; <!-- wp:pattern {"slug":"..."} /--> is expanded into the pattern's blocks on import. "{{theme}}" stands for the theme folder URL. "screens" lists the URL of each catalogue page. "productCategories", "productTags" and "products" are imported by inc/woo-import.php, only while WooCommerce is active; each product's "Layers of lacquer" attribute is the single source of the layer count shown on cards and product pages. The workshop address, hours and email, and the fallback shelf, are not in this file: they live in synced patterns (inc/shared-info.php, inc/info/*.html) that every page references.

posts.title: Why thirty-six coats?
posts.excerpt: Our jubako carries thirty-six coats of urushi. Taku explains where each one goes and what it adds.
posts.content:
Our jubako carries thirty-six coats of urushi. Taku explains where each one goes and what it adds.

At the bench

Every coat is thin enough to see the brush marks level out in the first minute. Then the piece goes into the cabinet, and nothing more can be done until tomorrow.

It is slow on purpose. A thick coat would skin over and wrinkle; a thin one cures right through and can be ground back to a perfect plane.

At the table

What you notice is not the count but the depth: the way a black bowl seems to hold the light a little below its surface.

Lacquer cannot be hurried. It only answers to time and to air.

Nao Ebisawa
